# Projects

A portfolio of data science, machine learning, business intelligence, and software engineering projects. Each subdirectory is a self-contained project with its own documentation, code, and reports.

## Projects

| # | Project | Domain | Tech Stack |
|---|---------|--------|-----------|
| 1 | [Classification of Facial Images](Classification%20of%20Facial%20Images/) | Computer Vision | Python, scikit-learn, CNN |
| 2 | [Credit Card Fraud Detection](Credit%20card%20fraud%20detection/) | Anomaly Detection | Python, ML classifiers |
| 3 | [Dunkin' Donuts Business Intelligence](Dunkin'%20Donuts%20Business%20Intelligence/) | Business Intelligence | BI tools, dashboards, sentiment analysis |
| 4 | [Effectiveness of Data Synthesized by Generative AI](Effectiveness%20of%20Data%20Synthesized%20by%20Generative%20AI%20in%20Supervised%20Image%20Classification/) | Generative AI / CV | Python, CNN, Stable Diffusion |
| 5 | [EDA on eCommerce Dataset](Exploratory%20Data%20Analysis%20(EDA)%20on%20eCommerce%20Dataset/) | Data Analysis | Python, Pandas, Matplotlib |
| 6 | [Grocery Store Management System](Grocery%20Store%20Management%20System/) | Full-Stack App | Python, SQL, HTML/CSS |
| 7 | [Leveraging Chess Game Data](Leveraging%20Chess%20Game%20Data%20for%20Player%20Performance%20Prediction/) | Predictive Modeling | Python, Decision Trees, Lichess data |
| 8 | [Oceanographic Parameter Prediction](Oceanographic%20Parameter%20Prediction%20using%20CalCOFI%20Dataset/) | Environmental ML | Python, Regression, CalCOFI |
| 9 | [HR Performance Dashboards](Performance%20Dashboards%20for%20Human%20Resources%20Management/) | Data Visualization | Tableau |
| 10 | [Predicting Financial Market Trends](Predicting%20Financial%20Market%20Trends/) | Time Series | Python, ARIMA, Prophet, XGBoost |
| 11 | [Scholarly Search Engine](Scholarly%20Search%20Engine%20for%20Academic%20Papers/) | Information Retrieval | Python, Django, SQLite, ranking algorithms |
| 12 | [Synthetic Data Toolkit](Synthetic%20Data%20Toolkit%20Creation/) | Privacy / Synthetic Data | Python, CTGAN, GaussianCopula, SDV |
| 13 | [Topic Modeling for COVID-19 Research](Topic%20Modeling%20for%20COVID-19%20Research/) | NLP | Python, LDA, NMF, Gensim, Streamlit |

## Skills and Technologies

| Category | Tools |
|----------|-------|
| Languages | Python, SQL, HTML/CSS |
| ML / DL | scikit-learn, TensorFlow/Keras, XGBoost, Gensim |
| Data | Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn |
| BI / Viz | Tableau, Plotly |
| Web | Django, Streamlit, Flask |
| Databases | SQLite, Snowflake, SQL Server |
| Generative AI | Stable Diffusion, CTGAN, GaussianCopula (SDV) |
| Other | Git, Jupyter Notebooks |

## Getting Started

1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/SteffiDorothy/Projects.git
   cd Projects
   ```

2. **Explore a project:** Each folder contains its own `README.md` (or `readme.md`) with project-specific setup instructions.

3. **Run notebooks:** Most ML projects use Jupyter notebooks. Install dependencies and launch:
   ```bash
   pip install jupyter pandas scikit-learn matplotlib seaborn
   jupyter notebook
   ```

4. **Web applications** (Grocery Store, Scholarly Search, Topic Modeling) have their own `requirements.txt` — install with `pip install -r requirements.txt` inside the project folder.

## Repository Structure

```
Projects/
├── Classification of Facial Images/        # CNN image classification
├── Credit card fraud detection/            # Anomaly detection models
├── Dunkin' Donuts Business Intelligence/   # BI dashboards & analysis
├── Effectiveness of Data Synthesized.../   # Synthetic data + CNN research
├── Exploratory Data Analysis.../           # eCommerce EDA
├── Grocery Store Management System/        # Full-stack Python/SQL app
├── Leveraging Chess Game Data.../          # Decision tree regression
├── Oceanographic Parameter Prediction../   # Environmental ML
├── Performance Dashboards for HR.../       # Tableau dashboards
├── Predicting Financial Market Trends/     # Time series forecasting
├── Scholarly Search Engine.../             # Django search engine
├── Synthetic Data Toolkit Creation/        # Privacy-preserving data gen
└── Topic Modeling for COVID-19.../         # NLP topic extraction + app
```
